ModMetaData.name: Save Options
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Save Options combines automatic saves on negative events, save-and-quit buttons, and automatic loading of your latest save. Each feature has its own toggle under Options - Mod options - Save Options.
Negative events and major threats save to "Bad Event", with an adjustable cooldown and optional event names. Saves happen between ticks and wait while saving is temporarily disabled.
Save and Quit saves under your colony's name before returning to the menu or exiting. Hold Alt to use the normal quit buttons. Commitment mode keeps its normal quit behavior. An optional "Start" save captures each new colony once its starting drop pods have landed.
Auto Load Last Save loads the most recently modified save on startup, including autosaves. Press any key or click during the countdown to stay at the menu. Returning to the menu never triggers another automatic load. If an automatic load fails or crashes, the next launch stays at the menu.
Disable the separate Save on Negative Event, Save and Quit, and Auto Load Last Save mods when using Save Options.
